adopted_question_verbatim: How many antique items did I inherit or acquire from my family members?
adopted_answer_or_rubric_verbatim: 5 groups: tea set, typewriter, diamond necklace, music box, glassware set
english_rubric: Require five groups: tea set, typewriter, diamond necklace, music box, glassware set. Sets count as one group, not individual pieces.
